title: Senior Property Accountant
notes: Very short JD with no explicit requirements section. Must-haves come from 'The ideal candidate comes from Public Accounting with Real Estate clients OR directly from a Real Estate company' - two alternative backgrounds, phrased as ideal. Years range 3-7 phrased as 'ideal'; lower bound taken.

title: Software Engineer Senior

evidence.min_years: 5+ years of relevant on the job experience in Software Engineering

notes: Java 'strongly preferred' but other OO languages accepted; kept as must since programming in an OO language is required. Bachelor's degree omitted (not a skill). Many bonus tools (Maven, Gradle, Splunk, Prometheus, Dynatrace, Cucumber, etc.) cut by the 6-item cap. Domain: payments platform.

title: Gaming Business Analyst
notes: Title silent on level; seniority from min_years 5. T-SQL, Power BI, Power Apps and data warehousing appear as 'Strong in ...' in the Responsibilities block, treated as required; Required Skills block lists SQL, Excel, data analysis, communication.

title: Business Analyst

evidence.min_years: 10+ years of experience in business analysis
evidence.seniority: 10+ years of experience in business analysis

notes: JD never states a job title; 'Business Analyst' inferred from '10+ years of experience in business analysis' and duties. Seniority from min_years (>=10 -> lead); duties include leading teams. Degree omitted. 'Advanced technical skills' too vague to label.

title: Senior Data Engineer

evidence.min_years: 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer

notes: Required list is longer than 8: also kubernetes, git, ci/cd, nosql, microservices, event-driven architecture, data quality checks (cut by cap). Python 'or Scala/Java'. Domain: medical aesthetics business of a pharma company (AbbVie/Allergan).

title: Accountant
notes: No job title stated; 'Accountant' inferred from duties (journal entries, reconciliations, financial statements). All qualifications are under 'Preferred Qualifications', so no must-haves. No years and no level -> seniority null. Domain: faith-based non-profit (scripture procurement, staff devotions).

title: Angular Developer
notes: No explicit title; 'Angular Developer' inferred from key skills. Seniority from min_years 7. Mandatory certification 'Angular Level 1 Level 2'. Node.js and CSS only 'basic working knowledge'. PrimeNG, AgGrid, Git, VSCode, SPA development also listed as skills (cut by cap). Employer is IT consulting (LTIMindtree); end client unknown.

title: Software Engineer

evidence.min_years: Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering roles
evidence.seniority: Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering roles

notes: Title silent on level; seniority from min_years 2 -> mid. Required list also has HTML, CSS, T-SQL, WebAPI, design patterns, OO design, agile, git (cut by cap). Preferred also BDD, Jira/Confluence, mobile development, SaaS experience. Domain: SaaS for landscaping/field services businesses.

title: Staff Engineer
notes: 'Staff' is not in the guideline's title mapping, so seniority falls back to min_years 7 -> senior; arguably lead (role mentions leading architecture/teams). Also required: Kubernetes, TensorRT, TensorFlow (or PyTorch), 3D geometry, SLAM/tracking subjects, MS/PhD degree (cut by cap / degree omitted). Domain: autonomous trucking logistics.

title: Application Software Engineering V
notes: Level 'V' is not in the title mapping; seniority from min_years 15 -> lead (also 12+ years in architecture). Kubernetes and mentoring from 'Knowledge, Skills And Abilities' treated as required. Staffing agency post for an unnamed client; domain unclear (mentions 'Dispatch' architecture).

title: Data Engineer

evidence.min_years: Minimum of 5 years of experience building robust and scalable data pipelines
evidence.seniority: Minimum of 5 years of experience building robust and scalable data pipelines

notes: Title given only as 'a seasoned data engineer'; 'seasoned' is not in the mapping, so seniority from min_years 5. AWS is 'preferred' within cloud architecture requirement -> nice. CI and multi-modal data handling also required (cut by cap).

title: Lead Data Engineer

evidence.min_years: 8 to 10 years of experience working in data engineering

notes: Skills introduced as 'Ideal candidate will have the following skills' but form the only requirements list, so treated as must. AWS services named: EC2, EMR, RDS, Redshift. DBT explicitly 'is plus'. No industry stated.

title: Software Developer
notes: Ansible/AWX/Tower is explicit hard requirement. Skills list also includes REST API, Kubernetes, OpenShift, agile, code review, testing (cut by cap). No years and no level in title -> seniority null. Staffing-firm post; client industry unknown.

title: CAD Designer

evidence.min_years: 5 or more years of experience designing PCBAs and writing firmware
evidence.seniority: 5 or more years of experience designing PCBAs and writing firmware

notes: No formal title line; 'CAD designer' is how the overview names the role, though duties are electrical/firmware engineering. BS in Electrical Engineering required (degree omitted). Linux RTOS 'preferred' in duties. Domain inferred from 'unmanned vehicle sensors'.

title: Staff Accountant

evidence.min_years: 2- 4 years of professional experience in accounting
evidence.seniority: 2- 4 years of professional experience in accounting

notes: 'Staff' not in the title mapping; seniority from min_years 2 -> mid. External audits and budgeting appear only in the 'ideal candidate' intro, so put in nice-to-have. Degree omitted.
